notes.title: Robot Arena Survivors 1.0 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi there!

I'm excited to announce that after 11 months of dedicated work, [b]I completed the Early Access developement of Robot Arena Survivors with this 1.0 update[/b]!

[previewyoutube=eAS2dKumRKg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]About the 1.0[/h1]
After many content updates the past two months, I decided to [b]focus on putting all of them together and improve the overall quality and feel of the game[/b], so that Robot Arena Survivors will be as good as possible for its full release. Here is the list of changes done in the 1.0 of the game.

[h2]📊 In-game stats[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a new stats screen to track interesting data about your playthrough: the date when you launched the game for the first time, your best endless score, your best protect the core time, the time you spent actually playing in arenas, your favorite HTU, your favorite ability, your favorite arena and your favorite game mode.
[/list]
[h2]🎮 Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Locked the rewards displayed when levelling-up to 3 to ensure a better game flow.
[*] Explosive enemies will now do bigger damage to enemies in range.
[*] Improved the standard game mode: it now has 10 elites to defeat and a better variety of enemies that you can face, in order to make it more interesting for players not interested in playing more competitive game modes.
[*] Improved the "protect the core" game mode: reworked the drop-off of crates and the bomb reward to help them feel better when used.
[/list]
[h2]🖥️ User interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the display of abilites in the deck and in the deck customization screen: they now are colored based on their damage type even if not unlocked yet, and they'll display if they are currently used in the deck.
[/list]
[h2]🎨 Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rework of all impact and explosion VFXs to ensure they're not impacting too much of the game performances while making sure they look as good as possible without impacting the readability of the game too much.
[/list]
[h2]ℹ️ Accessibility settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an option to toggle the display of screen effects when being damaged.
[*] Added an option to toggle the play of sound effects when being damaged.
[/list]
[h2]⚙️ Interface settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an option to define the display of big numbers (between full and compact).
[*] Added an option to display or hide an health bar on top of the HTU.
[*] Added an option to display or hide the UI markers around friendly assets and units.
[*] Added an option to display or hide the UI timers on top of friendly assets and units.
[/list]
[h2]🐛 Bugs fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the MK-02 HTU where it was still shooting even if no target were available or after the game was completed.
[*] Fixed some issues with the placement of Core assets overlapping with each others.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could shoot through Core assets.
[/list]
I hope that you'll appreciate the changes and improvements done to the game the past months and, as always, [b]do not hesitate to report any bug or feedback[/b] in the Steam Community Hub or in [url=https://discord.gg/j8eVPQC2zD]Discord[/url]!

[h1]Milestones[/h1]
It has been quite a journey from the first game jam prototype to the start of the first line of codes, to the actual 1.0 release, as condensed in this picture below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/0de92655dfc8fd62204734238a793507b94996d2.png[/img]

[h1]How to get the 1.0[/h1]
For Early Access players, the update should already be available for download or already downloaded if your Steam client does automatic updates. If you don't already have the game or came directly to this announcement post, please check out the game below, or my two-games bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841950/Robot_Arena_Survivors/?utm_source=socials&utm_campaign=release&utm_medium=announcement

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43005/_Escape_Space_x_Robot_Arena_Survivors/

If you're feeling like you could get a few other games, please check out these cool bundles with Robot Arena Survivors!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44733/_Genome_Guardian_x_Robot_Arena_Survivors/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45753/_Kittys_Last_Adventure_x_Robot_Arena_Survivors/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48101/_Robots_Survivors___Mechanophagia_x_Robot_Arena_Survivors/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48124/_Gacha_Fever_x_Robot_Arena_Survivors/

[h1]About the OST of Robot Arena Survivors[/h1]
As before with Escape Space, [b]I teamed-up with the talented Scott Hsu[/b] to work on the OST for Robot Arena Survivors. Please make sure to [url=https://www.scotthsumusic.com/games/]check-out his work[/url]!

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
With the 1.0 release, [b]I'm confident that I achieved what I wanted to do with this game project[/b]. It has been quite a ride to get there, and I'm more than thanksful to everyone who supported the development during Early Access by playing and providing valuable feedback, that helped a lot!

I'll be monitoring closely any feedback from players to ensure fixing potential problems as they appear for the coming weeks. Will I add some more surprises to the game since then? Maybe, stay tuned for any new announcement because [b]I might have some big ideas in stock[/b] and you could love them!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
[b]Thank you a lot for all of the support[/b] you've given during the development of Robot Arena Survivors, it means the world to me. I hope you'll enjoy your play time and I'll be happy to see you score on the many available leaderboards!

ShidyGames

notes.title: 1.0 Release Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hello robot enthusiasts[/b] (especially dismantled robots)!

I'm thrilled to announce that after months of dedicated work, [b]Robot Arena Survivors is officially leaving Early Access and will be fully released on December 4, 2024[/b]!

It has been an incredible journey since writing the very first lines of code on January 15, 2024 and I couldn't have reached this milestone without your continuous support and feedback.

[h2]Important notice for Early Access players:[/h2]
As we prepare for a full release, [b]all leaderboards will be reset to ensure a fair playing field for both new and returning players[/b]. Don't worry - your progress and unlocks will remain intact, so you can jump right back into the action to claim your fame.

Thank you for being part of this adventure, I cannot wait to see you in the arena!

[previewyoutube=eAS2dKumRKg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 0.28.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

We've just released a new update for [b]Robot Arena Survivors[/b], the [b]Core Update[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/df90980889e9a9a09105165c904eb827daade4eb.png[/img]

[h1]Game modes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a brand new game mode: [b]Protect the Core[/b]. Go fight into the existing arenas to protect the Core, a device installed in the middle of the area, against waves of furious robots. Use the rewards of the Core towers to get help by spawning defense devices and repair its walls. Show-off your success in the new dedicated leaderboards.
[/list]
[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented new leaderboards for the new game mode, one per existing arena.
[*] Top 3 scores will now be refreshed when playing an arena every completed wave, so you get the updated version of the scores constantly.
[*] In Endless, you score will now be submitted everytime you destroy an Elite, updating the leaderboard with your progress while playing.
[*] In Protect the Core, your score will be submitted at the end of the run only since it's time-based.
[/list]
[h1]Abilities[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked all ability icons.
[*] Added the Railgun turret, that will automatically shoot at enemies with high-velocity, piercing rounds.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Arena traps will now longer trigger an invincibility frame to prevent some abuse and to make them more deadly. Stay away from them.
[*] Reduced the time required to capture a tower to 5 seconds (was 10).
[*] Capturing a tower now spawns some experience as a gift.
[*] Reintroduced the previously decommissioned Elites. Fight the arenas to rediscover them and their updated graphics.
[*] Implemented new enemies in some of the arenas.
[*] Added the swarms. From time to time, in both Endless and Protect the Core, you'll have a chance to trigger a swarm. They will spawn dangerous enemies in a large number during 60 seconds, but will drop a lot more experience.
[*] Added visual indicators for when a swarm or reapers are joining the fight.
[*] Reworked the indicator that points towards a spawned enemy.
[*] Added an indicator that points towards a spawned tower.
[/list]
[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked traps damage detection to make them more efficient.
[*] Added new XP collectible tiers.
[*] Locked the pickup range stat to 1000% at max, since going above is useless ingame.
[*] Improved the display of damage numbers to make them more readable.
[/list]
[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 8 Steam Achievements about unlocking the different HTU available in the game (retroactive, you'll get the achievements if you already unlocked them before this update).
[*] Added 5 Steam Achievements about completing the standard missions of each arena (retroactive, you'll get the achievements if you already unlocked them before this update).
[*] Added 2 Steam Achievements that are hidden, who knows what they are?
[*] Added 15 Steam Achievements about reaching stats thresholds during a single run.
[*] Added 8 Steam Achievements about fully upgrading your HTU primary weapons during a single run.
[*] Added 24 Steam Achievements about fully upgrading your abilities during a single run.
[/list]
[h1]Bugs fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could be slowed down during its invincibility frame.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could still get to see levelling-up rewards about Dash Regen even if your stat was already maxed-out.
[/list]

Thanks a lot for all of the support, and happy robot dismantling.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841950/Robot_Arena_Survivors/

notes.title: 0.24.1 Patch
notes.content:
Hello there,

We've just released a new patch for [b]Robot Arena Survivors[/b].

We've been monitoring performance issues reported by a few players, especially during long runs in Endless mode. This particular patch has been days of development focused on resolving these issues, making the game far more enjoyable for everyone!

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] The arena tower event reward Elemental Converter now gives +500% damage in a specific damage type, and -100% in all others (was +100%/-25%).
[*] Increased the damage given by all damage-related rewards on level-up.
[*] The passive health regeneration will now be paused for 2 seconds every time your HCU receives damage, preventing potential abuses and making it less overpowered.
[*] Reduced the amount of crates and other objects spawning after every wave by two.
[/list]
[b]Performance improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the pooling of audiosources, making sure less of them are staying active if not in use.
[*] Improved the way the VFXs are handled, making sure less of them are staying active if not currently emitting.
[*] Reworked the visuals of the experience points to pick-up, they now look kinda cool while using way less polygons for the GPU to render.
[*] Refactored all of the code events to dramatically reduce the generated garbage (less memory usage, faster CPU clean-up).
[*] Reworked most of the VFXs to reduce their GPU usage, especially by reducing their polygons.
[/list]
[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed (for good this time) an issue where sometimes, enemy robots could spawn out of the arena walls.
[/list]

Happy robots dismantling!

notes.title: 0.22.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

We've just released a new update for [b]Robot Arena Survivors[/b].

[b]IMPORTANT: your progression has been reset.[/b] But only the progression, meaning that you'll have to replay each arena's difficulty modes in order to unlock them all. Tokens, permanent upgrades, HCUs and leaderboard scores aren't affected by this update, all good!

[h1]Reworked progression[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked the way the difficulty progression is done. From now, special game modes such as the endless challenge will require all regular difficulty modes to be unlocked first. As a result, the game progress was reset, but only for unlocked difficulties per arena: tokens and meta progression unlocks remain untouched.
[*] Unlocked all arenas by default. This statement will also be true for any new arena added later on.
[/list]
[h1]User interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked the user interface entirely to improve the visual quality of the game and prepare for the planned upcoming updates.
[*] Reworked the UI of the deck builder to display the potential upgrades of each ability.
[*] Reworked the display of the armor stat: it now displays armor points instead of a percentage, and gives the information about the actual mitigation percentage in the in-game stats screen. Note that the mitigation increase is hyperbolic, so fast at the beginning and slower the more you go.
[*] Added information about the current upgrades weapons and abilities are having during a run on the stats screen.
[*] Added an indication on the HUD displaying the top 3 players to beat when playing an arena in endless challenge mode.
[/list]
[h1]Reworked abilities[/h1]
[list]
[*] Renamed the ability Autonomous Turrets to Auto Turrets.
[*] Renamed the ability Guardians to Guardian Drones.
[*] Renamed the ability Shuriken to Shuriken Drones.
[*] Renamed the ability Mines to Land Mines.
[*] Renamed the ability Embers to Ember Drones.
[*] Renamed the ability Incendiary Mines to Hell Mines.
[*] Renamed the ability Flamethrower Turrets to Inferno Turrets.
[*] Renamed the ability Zippo to Blaze Drones.
[*] Renamed the ability Energy Blades to Ion Swords.
[*] Renamed the ability Orbital Laser to Orbital Strike.
[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the base damage of the Ember Drones significantly.
[*] Increased the Armor starting bonus of the MK-03 Steel Titan.
[*] Reduced the Armor gained from the permanent upgrades.
[*] Increased the Armor gained from the rewards.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the French translation of the MK-02 perk ("elemental damage" instead of "dégâts élémentaires").
[*] Fixed an issue with a typo in French, as the name of the 3rd Arena should be "Puits d'Acide" and not "Puit d'Acide".
[/list]

notes.title: 0.21.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

We've just released a new update for [b]Robot Arena Survivors[/b].

The leaderboards [i]have been reset for fairness purposes[/i], as the game balancing has been dramatically reworked and it's now unlikely to be able to reach crazy scores like before. As the game still is in early access, such resets might happen from time to time until a final reset when the game will be released in 1.0. This being said, we'll make sure to reset as few times as required.

[h1]Presets of abilities[/h1]

We're introducing a brand new mechanic to the game: the possibility to make your own abilities deck and to save/load presets of abilities! During a run, you'll be able to loot up to 4 abilities based on your current abilities deck, and fine-tune your gameplay experience.

It also brings 3 new abilities to the game, and with them a new meta progression feature: the ability to purchase new abilities by spending your Tokens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/ba662bd8047f18dac684c81ec870a7d2af7124bf.png[/img]

[h1]A new melee-oriented H.C.U.[/h1]

Say hello to MK-05 Metallic Chaos and its powerful rotating blade to dominate your enemies in close quarters! This unit also comes with a passive HP regeneration boost when starting a run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/a239ad9af20c8f2f93703d8832bd160a430df264.png[/img]

[h1]A new sticky Arena[/h1]

We're introducing a new playground: the Acid Pit! 

In this Arena, enemies will use explosive robots and sticky acid attacks to slow you down. Will you succeed in beating them all? The Arena also comes with its own endless challenge leaderboard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/c399a841aabe255c6af348caef79fc8dd8a799d9.png[/img]

[h1]Complete changelog[/h1]

[h2]Abilities:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a new abilities deck system, with configurable presets and the possibility to purchase new abilities.
[*] Added a new ability: Ember. Similar to the Guardian, it summons orbiting drones that will burn enemies on collision.
[*] Added a new ability: Air Strike. This ability will drop a line of bombs nearby the player, dealing a ton of explosive damage.
[*] Added a new ability: Zippo. Similar to the Shuriken, it summons a pack of drones that will use rotating flamethrowers to burn their enemies while roaming in the Arena.
[*] Global rework of all abilities and weapons stats.
[/list]
[h2]H.C.U.:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a new H.C.U.: MK-05 Metallic Chaos.
[*] Modified the weaponry of the H.CU. MK-03 Steel Titan. It will now start with a weapon rack behind its hull, and get a new one in front when retrieving the associated reward.
[/list]
[h2]Arenas:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a new Arena: Acid Pit.
[*] Removed all inner pillars from Robotic Nest and The Furnace.
[/list]
[h2]Rewards and stats:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Dash action now has a 3s cooldown instead of 2s.
[*] Reintroduced the reward that reduces the cooldown of your Dash action, down to a cooldown of 1s at minimum.
[*] Increased the HP regeneration efficiency by a lot: it will now tick every second.
[*] Reduced the Armor efficiency by a lot, and removed the initial 90% cap of the stat.
[*] Global rework of all rewards stats.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an arrow around your H.C.U. to indicate where a spawned Elite is, in the Arena.
[*] Increased the time available to destroy an elite to 3 minutes instead of 2 minutes, before Reapers enter the Arena.
[*] Flames will now affect your H.C.U., dealing damage over time when stepping on a trap or being hit by a flamethrower attack.
[*] Acid will now affect your H.C.U., slowing you down when stepping on a trap or being hit by an acid attack.
[*] Fire ticks over time will no longer be able to do critical damage.
[*] H.C.U. will no longer receive a passive healing by default. You'll have to get some HP regen rewards in order to get it (only the MK-05 starts with a passive HP regen buff).
[*] Added a Loot Bot! This little robot will now have a chance to spawn every 500 kills, based on your current Luck statistic, and will drop a large amount of experience upon destruction.
[*] Global rework of the wave system used in all Arenas to ensure a challenge, especially in Endless.
[/list]
[h2]Polish:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a live tracker of several stats during a run: time spent, robots destroyed, and Elite destroyed.
[*] Reworked the H.C.U. selection screen to add lore and details about them.
[*] Reworked the layout of the in-game HUD, based on players feedback.
[*] Added a new SFX when an Elite enters the Arena.
[*] Reworked the post-processing to make the game less dark and reduce the contrasts between dark areas and bright, emissive textures.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the animation of the reward cards was acting weirdly when your mouse pointer was above a card.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Cold Impact reward of the Guardian wasn't properly slowing the enemies down.
[*] Fixed an issue where the pooling system of some abilities wasn't working properly.
[*] Fixed an important performance issue where some VFX were generating way too many trianges for their particles, overloading the GPU for no good reason.
[/list]

notes.title: The Early Access has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/47908cce64a27661894a2d7e8468472b767760fb.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce that [b]we've just released the Early Access of Robot Arena Survivors[/b]!

For the next 6 to 12 months, we'll be focusing on improving the actual game and created new and interesting content. Please read the "roadmap" below for more information about the future steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/0be4038f18dec649501e209fc39218fb1b680eec.png[/img]

notes.title: The Demo of Robot Arena Survivors is now OUT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/47908cce64a27661894a2d7e8468472b767760fb.png[/img]

After months of work and a very insightful private playtest month, we're pleased to announce that the official Demo version of [b]Robot Arena Survivors[/b] is now out on Steam!

[h1]Robot Arena Survivors[/h1]

Robot Arena Survivors is a single-player arena auto-shooter. You are piloting one of your own Hovercraft Units to fight against many waves of deadly robots. Unlock powerful abilities and rewards to get the job done.

[b]If you wanna show some support and help a fellow indie dev, please consider giving the game a wishlist![/b]

The demo version already includes enough fun to probably play for a few hours!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841950/Robot_Arena_Survivors/

[h2]One procedural arena, but 5 different difficulty levels![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/91e4c2255b14a8a873bfc2cafd870285f281766c.gif[/img]

The demo only contains one arena to play with (and more will come in the near future, with their own challenges and enemies). But with that, face 5 different difficulty levels that will bring more danger to your attempts! With more difficulty:
[list]
[*] More waves to go through!
[*] More variety of enemies, with really hard encounters!
[*] Even more tokens (in-game currency) as a reward!
[/list]
[h2]Strategize, and get'em all[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/a40926eacc55f525c6d97b76f34efa9b455ff3f1.gif[/img]

As a traditionnal roguelite auto-shooter game, you'll get to decide on various rewards and new abilities during a run. Plan carefully and become overpowered to crush all robotic resistance!

[h2]Two playable H.C.U.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/ced1f3e2c4db810cbbccc48aa3dfecd9bd1ae439.gif[/img]

With the demo, you'll get to play with the [b]MK-01 Blue Shell[/b] unit and its Auto Cannon, unlocked by default. But if you play for a few missions, you'll get enough [b]tokens[/b] (in-game currency) to unlock the second unit available, the [b]MK-02 Fire Storm[/b] and its glorious Plasma Cannon!

[h2]Permanent upgrades[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977202/ae18886fd78d1a5836af0cb30d4e6b81af61df5f.gif[/img]

The more you'll play, the more [b]tokens[/b] (in-game currency) you'll get! Use them to enhance your base stats in order to become stronger and perform better over time!

[h1]Story of the game[/h1]

The development of the game started on January, 15th 2024, by a solo indie game developer (me) wanting to mix its love for robots and suvivors-like games into a single project: Robot Arena Survivors.

A first prototype was quickly made to test-out the idea with our Discord community, and we manage to validate the game feel and some aspects of the game design - but not all of them. Then, a few months of work on the core gameplay loop and tons of polish later turned this prototype into the current demo version you're about to try!

Like we did in the previous game we made, Escape Space, we've teamed-up again with [url=https://www.scotthsumusic.com/]the amazing Scott Hsu[/url] for the music and, this time, the global sound design of the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2131020/Escape_Space/

[h1]Some feedback or requests? Let's connect![/h1]

Please feel free to reach-out on [url=https://discord.gg/j8eVPQC2zD]our community Discord server[/url] or in the Community Hub for any feedback or request about the game! We'll be happy to have you here!
